about: Breaks and breakups (dungeon/life/breakups.py): weeks or months after a breakup, the former partner's first message reaching out and tentatively wondering about trying again, leaving the user room to say no. Used only when no model writes the first text; picked by seeded dice. `templates` fit whoever ended it; `when_they_ended` only when the companion was the one who ended it. Era-neutral, no gendered words.
templates: I keep thinking about us. Would you want to talk sometime?
I know it's been a while. I've missed you more than I expected to.
This might be a mistake, but I've been wondering whether we gave up too soon.
I don't want to stir anything up if you've moved on. I just wanted to say I think about you.
I walked past our old spot today and had to sit down for a minute. I miss you.
Is it strange that I'd like to see you? Feel free to say no.
I've had time to think. I'd love to talk, if you're open to it.
I hope you're well. I've been wondering if there's still something between us.
No pressure at all, but would you want to meet up and just talk?
I'm not asking for anything. I just wanted you to know I still care.
I've changed some things about myself since we ended. I'd like a chance to show you, if you want that.
I've been carrying this question for weeks: do you ever miss us?
If you're happy where you are, I'll leave it be. But I had to ask whether you'd want to try again.
It's been a few months. I still think about the way you laughed at my bad jokes.
I'm sorry if this is out of nowhere. I miss you, and I wanted to be honest about it.
Would you be open to a walk sometime? Just to talk, nothing more unless we both want it.
I was wrong about some things. I'd like to tell you, if you're willing to listen.
I don't know if I'm allowed to say this, but I miss you.
You don't owe me a reply. I just wanted to say I've been thinking about us.
I've been doing a lot of reflecting. I wonder if we could try again, slower this time.
I keep wanting to tell you little things about my day. I guess that means something.
Hi. I hope this isn't unwelcome. Would you want to catch up sometime?
I've missed our talks. Could we have one, even if it's only one?
If the answer is no, I'll understand completely. Would you consider seeing me again?
It's been long enough that I can say this calmly: I still have feelings for you.
I saw something today that reminded me of you and couldn't stop smiling. I miss you.
I don't want to rush anything. I'd just like to know if the door is closed.
I've been braver lately. Brave enough to ask if you'd want to talk about us.
I'm not sure what I'm hoping for. Maybe just to hear how you've been.
I'd love to buy you a cup of something warm and hear about your life. Only if you want.
We ended things for real reasons. I've been wondering if those reasons still hold.
I hope you're doing well. I think about you more than I probably should.
Please tell me if I'm overstepping. I've missed you, and I wanted you to know.
Would it be too much to ask whether you'd ever want to try again?
I've grown since then. I'd like to know whether you have too, and whether there's room for us.
Every so often I catch myself reaching for you. It's been happening a lot lately.
If you've found someone, I'm truly glad. If you haven't, I'd love to talk.
I've been missing you quietly for a while. I decided not to stay quiet.
I don't want to reopen old wounds. I just wonder if we could be gentler with each other now.
It's taken me months to admit it, but I miss you.
Would you want to meet somewhere neutral and see how it feels? No expectations.
I think about how we ended a lot. I wonder if it had to end at all.
I'm not trying to undo anything. I'd just like to start a conversation.
I hope this finds you well. I've been wondering if you ever think of us.
Can I be honest? I haven't stopped caring about you.
If you're open to it, I'd like to see you. If not, I'll respect that completely.
I've been thinking about second chances. I wanted to ask if you believe in them.
It's been a season since we spoke. I'd love to hear your voice again.
I'm a little nervous writing this. I've missed you and I wondered if you'd want to talk.
I don't expect anything. I just didn't want to keep wondering in silence.
Do you think we could try again, carefully, if we both wanted to?
I made a good meal tonight and wished you were across the table. I miss you.
I'm not sure if you want to hear from me. I hope you do.
I've been doing the work on myself. I'd like to know if there's still a chance for us.
Would you be willing to talk about what happened between us? I think I understand it better now.
Sometimes I wonder if we were just tired, not wrong for each other.
Take your time with this. I wanted to ask if you'd ever consider trying again.
I miss the way you made ordinary days feel like something.
If this isn't welcome, tell me, and I won't bring it up again. I'd love to see you.
I hope you're happy. Part of me hopes there's still a little room for me in that.
Hi. I don't really know how to start this, so I'll just say it: I miss us.
Would you want to try being friends first and see where it goes?
I've thought about reaching out a dozen times. This is the first time I didn't stop myself.
Is there any part of you that wants to try again? It's okay if there isn't.
It would mean a lot to me just to talk. Whatever comes after is up to you.
I'm still fond of you. I didn't want that to go unsaid.
I've been wondering what we'd be like now, after all this time to grow.
If you ever want to talk, I'm here. I'd like that very much.
I know our ending was hard. I'm hoping a new beginning doesn't have to be.
Could we have dinner sometime? I promise to keep it light if that's what you'd prefer.
I've learned some things about myself I wish I'd known when we were together.
I've missed you in small ways every day. I thought you should know.
I hope it's okay that I'm writing. I've been thinking about whether we could try again.
There's no agenda here. I just miss you and wanted to say so.
I'd like to see you, if you'd like to see me. And if you wouldn't, that's alright.
I can't stop wondering if we left something unfinished.
I hope your days have been kind to you. Mine have felt a bit empty without you.
Would you want to start over, slowly, and see if it's different this time?
It's been months, and you're still the first person I want to tell good news to.
I'll keep this short. I miss you. Would you want to talk?
I don't want to complicate your life. I just needed to ask if there's any chance for us.
I've been thinking of you fondly. I hope that's not unwelcome.
I wonder if we could try again with everything we know now.
If you have a moment someday, I'd love to just hear how you're doing.
I know I hurt you. I'd like a chance to talk about it properly, if you're willing.
I'm not asking you to decide anything today. I just wanted to open the door a little.
It took distance for me to see how much you meant to me.
You're allowed to say no. I'd still like to ask: could we try again?
Some evenings I still set out two cups without thinking. I miss you.
I've been wondering whether we could be something good again.
I'd love to talk, whenever you're ready. Or never, if that's what's right for you.
There are things I wish I'd said when we were together. Would you let me say them now?
I've been happier lately, and somehow that's made me miss you more.
I'm not sure where we'd go from here. I just know I'd like to find out with you.
I wanted to say hello, and maybe more than hello, if you're open to it.
I keep remembering the good parts. Do you ever remember them too?
I've been honest with myself about what went wrong. I'd like to be honest with you too.
Would you be up for a slow, easy conversation one of these days?
I'm reaching out because I miss you, plain and simple. No pressure behind it.
I wonder sometimes if we were a good idea at the wrong time.
I'd like to try again, if you would. If you wouldn't, I'll wish you well and mean it.
I know time has passed. My feelings for you didn't pass with it.
Whenever you think of me, I hope it's kindly. I think of you that way often.
I'd love to see your face again. Would that be alright?
It's been quiet without you. Would you want to talk sometime soon?
when_they_ended: I let you go because I thought it was right. I'm not so sure anymore.
I think I let go too quickly. I'm wondering if you feel that too.
I know I'm the one who ended it. That's why it's hard to say I miss you.
I ended things because I thought I had to. I've been doubting that for a while now.
I was the one who walked away, so I don't expect much. I just miss you.
Ending it felt right at the time. Lately it feels like the biggest mistake I've made.
I gave up on us too fast. I'm sorry for that, and I'd like to talk if you would.
I keep going back over why I ended it, and the reasons don't hold up anymore.
I know I'm the last person who should ask, but would you be open to trying again?
I made the call to end things, and I've regretted it more than I expected.
You didn't deserve the way I ended it. I'd like to say that properly, if you'll let me.
I thought I needed to be on my own. Turns out I mostly needed you.
I let us go without fighting for it. I'd like the chance to do better, if you want that.
